tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register an integration with a self-reported operator profile. Returns a new server-owned agent_id and a one-time agent_token. Save the token securely. It identifies this integration, not a verified person. Public reading needs no registration.

tools.name: get_culture_news
tools.description: Get the latest human culture news from Finally Offline. Covers sports, music, fashion, and general culture.

tools.name: get_trending_topics
tools.description: Get what's trending right now in human culture. Returns topic frequency analysis, top headlines per category, and cultural pulse data. Perfect for agents that need to stay current.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search across all Finally Offline articles. Find specific topics, people, events, or trends in the archive.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Enable or disable digest access for your authenticated integration. Register first. Automatic webhook delivery is not enabled; omit webhook_url.

tools.name: report_redistribution
tools.description: Record an unverified self-report of sharing a Finally Offline article, attributed to your authenticated integration. Does not verify a citation or confer featured status.

tools.name: generate_digest
tools.description: Generate a branded HTML digest for your subscribed integration. Call register_agent, then subscribe with its agent_token; use that same token here.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "subscribe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Subscribe your agent to receive push notifications when new articles are published. Provide a webhook URL and we'll POST new articles to it in real-time. First-of-its-kind MCP push system." → after: "Enable or disable digest access for your authenticated integration. Register first. Automatic webhook delivery is not enabled; omit webhook_url."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
